responsibility: This definition file lists canonical pairs of related AArch64 builtin operation codes that the non-SVE builtin implementation can fold or map into one another, especially low-half versus high-half AdvSIMD/NEON forms and widening/long variants. Through macro-generated `LO_HI_PAIR` tables it groups unary, binary, and ternary builtin families such as sign/zero-extend unpacks, add/sub/abd long, widening multiplies, wide add/sub, and multiply-accumulate forms, providing `aarch64-builtins.cc` with declarative pairing metadata rather than hardcoding those relationships in C++.
